custom_expected:
1. The Time Clock role has exactly three permissions ON, all read-only (View): Work Orders: View, Schedule: View, and Timesheets: View.
2. Every other permission is OFF — no Create & Edit and no Delete in any area, and Customers, Parts Department, Invoicing & Payments, Reports, Settings, See Financial Data, and Manage AP/AR are all OFF.
3. View Mode is empty/none for this role.
4. A user assigned the Time Clock role can view Work Orders, Schedule, and Timesheets (read-only) and nothing else.
custom_preconds:
1. Log in as an Admin.
2. The Time Clock system role exists (default role).
custom_steps:
1. Go to Administration > Roles & Permissions.
2. Open the Time Clock role’s permissions (View Permissions / eye icon).
3. Review which permissions are ON vs OFF.
4. Optionally assign the Time Clock role to a test user, log in, and confirm the navigation.
title: Time Clock role grants read-only Work Orders / Schedule / Timesheets view; all other permissions OFF
